english:
Weapon hits and Glaive Melee Hits build stacks of 'Siphoning Touch'. Maximum of 5 stacks. <solar Scorch /> damage does not count.

Reaching 1|2|3|4|5 stacks requires hits equal to approximately 26.7%|53.4%|80%|106%|133% of Magazine Capacity, rounded down.

Stowing the weapon consumes all stacks, restoring 30|60|90|105|120 HP at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks.

// Source says each qualifying hit grants a stack but also supplies magazine-based thresholds. The thresholds are preserved; the relationship between the two statements, including Glaive Melee progress, needs verification.

source.text:
4 Piece | Siphoning Touch

Upon scoring weapon damage instances or a Glaive Melee Attack:
Grants a stack of Siphoning Touch, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
x1 = ~26.7% of Mag | x2 = ~53.4% | x3 = ~80% | x4 = ~106% | x5 = ~133%
Scorch does not count for damage instances. Always rounds down.

On Weapon Stow:
Consumes all Siphoning Touch to restores HP, based on the stack amount.
30 | 60 | 90 | 105 | 120 HP restored.
